title: Decide which predictions may route automatically
description: Compare an unconditional top-label route, a score-only gate, and a guarded policy that also checks text evidence, mixed input, and product scope.
fixtureNote: These records and scores are illustrative labeled fixtures for learning policy behavior. They are not measured package accuracy or throughput results.

policies.label: Always accept the top label
policies.detail: Maximize automation and ignore every uncertainty signal.

policies.label: Gate on normalized score
policies.detail: Defer low scores but ignore input shape and product eligibility.

policies.label: Guard score and eligibility
policies.detail: Require 20 characters, one-language input, in-scope truth, and the score floor.
